milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the lantern (placed on an oak fence post at spawn-relative [5, 1, 5] via /setblock ~5 ~1 ~5 minecraft:lantern[hanging=false]) and face toward it, confirming visual observation. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range (lantern is ~7 blocks from spawn diagonally), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the lantern rather than facing away. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because the task is about observing/finding an object, not just reaching a location.
